failures.rule: brand/constitution.md, Article 6.1 and roles table; brand/ledger.md, A3; product/ui-constitution.md, Article 7
failures.place: Item title, "Carhartt Detroit jacket", beside the photo
failures.issue: The title is visibly heavier than the price lines beside it. It uses weight to establish hierarchy where text must be Regular and Medium is reserved for buttons and the selected tab. This is a visual finding; the numerical font weight cannot be established from the raster.

failures.place: White page ground, especially the large empty area below the action row
failures.issue: Visible fine grain and mottling extend over the white page. Texture is permitted only on the field.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md, E1, Article 4 C2 and Article 7.4; Part IV B2; product/ui-constitution.md, Article 7
failures.place: Full-width sky-to-lime band above the item
failures.issue: The bright, wide band gives the completed Sold status and platform mark a competing focal point. It contains neither the item, the money nor the shipping decision. Its visual prominence is not attached to the most important content, as C2 requires.

failures.rule: brand/constitution.md, Article 7.6, Part III Canvas and Part IV B28
failures.place: Whole phone screen, excluding the gray side gutters
failures.issue: The phone area is approximately 719 by 1536 image pixels. At 390 pixels wide it is about 833 pixels high, rather than the required 844. The supplied board therefore does not preserve the specified phone proportions.

across_options.issue: Outside the D6 amount treatment, B makes the Sold label heavier and the horizontal rule above Ship by Tuesday lighter than A and C. These alter status emphasis and divider contrast in a comparison meant to vary only the peak amount (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4; brand/ledger.md D6).

C has a faint additional outer edge around the Drop-off spots outline, most apparent along its top edge. A and B have a cleaner single contour. This is unrelated to D6 (brand/constitution.md Article 14.4; brand/ledger.md D6).
